batting.dismissal: c EJG Morgan b JH Kallis

batting.name: DJ Hussey

batting.dismissal: c AC Gilchrist b Azhar Mahmood

batting.dismissal: c Gurkeerat Singh b Azhar Mahmood

balls.text: six to end it, and they end at 149! it was shorter in length and he camped on the back foot, and smacked it over mid-wicket for a six!
and again, he was trying to pull it away but the lack of pace meant that he got nowhere close, they are off for a bye
beaten by the slowness of the delivery, wanted to pull it away but gets nowhere close to hitting it
round the wicket and he wants to crash it over the bowler again, misses the middle of the bat, gets it down to long-on for a single
and this time he's got it a six! seemed to have come off the bottom of the blade but the man has enough power to get it over the straight boundary for maximum
cracked away for a four, fuller and he opens his stance up and heaves it over mid-wicket for a four

gone, run-out, Mahmood's time in the middle was woeful and he's gone now! it was a leading edge to the backward point region, where Kallis fields well and gets it back to the keeper, Mahmood is halfway down the pitch but the non-striker is going nowhere, he's got to rush back but the only place he's rushing back is the dugout, caught well short of his crease
tries to slam it away but it's shorter in length and gets it back to the bowler
neatly opens the face of the bat and gets it away to point for a single
gives himself some room and drives it through the covers for a single
and now it goes away from the bat, lot of turn, can only defend it to the bowler
quicker, spinning back into the batsman and he's not able to get it away, hits his pads and rolls to the keeper
fuller on the off stump and driven to the extra-cover fielder for a single
on the middle stump, cramping him for room and he's only able to defend it to the leg side
fuller on the middle and tapped away to long-on for a single
outside the off stump, on a length and the lack of pace beats the outside edge, through to the keeper

goes over the top and very well caught by Senanayake! it was not a quick one, he got it high and almost handsome, the fielder was right on the edge of the circle and is able to judge that well enough to pouch it, another wicket at a crucial time for Kallis
short of length and he opens the face of the bat, runs it down to third-man for a single

fuller, pushed back to the bowler, who looks like he's fumbled it, the batsmen wanted a single and Narine tries to get a run-out at the non-striker's end, misses the stumps and they are finally able to get away for a single
pushed it away to the leg side this time and they are off for a single
wants to nudge it away but does not get any bat there, hits the pads and bounces off it, the keeper gets there to field
swept and it goes on the bounce to Rajat Bhatia at the deep square-leg region
taps it to the off side, read that away going ball well and takes a quick one
big appeal for an lbw, the ball was turning back into the batsman and hits his pad but the umpire thinks it might be hitting outside the off
on the middle stump and is able to flick it away to the leg side for a single

direct hit, appeal for a run-out! was pushed into the covers and wanted to go for a single, there's a direct hit there but the batsman is well in, which is what the third ump says too! Ladda did well to field there
Pathans misfielded it again, it was swept away to backward square-leg and he's allowed it to go through for a four, bad, bad fielding
outside the off stump and on a length, he goes back and defends back
carrom ball, a tad quicker on the middle stump and tucked it away to the leg side
slower from round the stumps, he was looking to cut it away and gets it in the gap too, almost beats Balaji at deep point but does well to pull it back in
slower this time, taps it away through the covers for a single
short of length and cut away for a single

bowled him, keeps low and sneaks through there! that's a big wicket, Miller is an in-form batsman but this time he's beaten by the pace and also does not bounce as much as he would have wanted, is rooted on the back foot and the ball goes through and uproots the stumps!
wants to drive it through the covers but gets no timing on it
not this time, not at all! it was fullish and the batsman came down the track to thwack it over the bowler's head for a six, it was hit sweetly, not too hard, but timed well
and beaten again, this time by Ladda, who gets it to turn back into the batsman,
that's quicker one that spins away from Hussey, who reads it well, pushes it to backward point and wants a single but is sent back
shortish again and is able to tap it away to long-on for a single
almost a wicket, he was going for a drive but the spin away from the batsman beats the outside edge
shortish in length and that's easily punched through mid-wicket for a couple of runs
fuller from Narine, slow tap to the leg side between long-on and mid-wicket and calls for a second even before he's run his first, good fielding keeps them down to 1
shortish in length and is able to push it away to the long-off region for a single
short of length and is able to play it through the backward point region to the third-man fielder, who runs across to his right, is able to get him a couple

but now he's caught at deep cover! six and out is what Brett Lee would say in the dugout, it was wide and he went over the in-field on the square boundary off-side, not able to time it well, straight to the fielder at deep cover
and now it's off the middle of the bat, on yes it is! it was shorter in length probably because Balaji expected him to come down the track, he did shimmy down and clears it over the in-field
edged and through the right of the keeper for a four, it was pitched right up to the bat and the batsman was probably walking down to play a stroke before tapping out his bat, gets an edge
short of length from the bowler and he's only able to push it through to the fielder
quicker for Bala, is angling back into the batsman, who is not able to get it away, it gets away to the off side
fuller from the bowler and he gets it over to long-on for a single
on the off stump and he pushes it towards the short cover fielder, Morgan fields it well and tries to throw down the stumps but ends up conceding an overthrow
short of length immediately after that previous fuller one, flicks it away to the leg side for a single
up and over and gets it through extra-cover for a four, that was a slower one and he waited for its arrival and gets it away to the fence
slows the pace down and he has to work it away through the leg side, the flick of the wrist gets him a single
outside the leg-stump and Hussey is able to drive it through to deep square-leg for only a single

fullish and on the off stump, it's tapped to the off side and they are off for a single, Gambhir throws it to the bowler and by the time Kallis collects it and whips off the bails, the batsman is in, the third umpire is called for but he's well in
changing his pace down well here, he's bowled that at 122.2 km/hr here and only gets a single to the off side
shorter in length and Hussey isn't able to get him away, just gets it back to the bowler
a very slow ball, shorter too and the batsman needed to adjust his stroke to be able to tap it through to third-man for a single
that's fuller in length and on the off stump, Hussey was looking to drive it through but gets it to mid-off and are off for a quick one
fullish on his pads and he's easily to flick it away to the leg side for a single
it's on a good length and Hussey drives it back to the bowler
fullish on the leg stump, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single
shot sir, that was a well played strike, it was on a length without any pace to work on it, he's able to get to the front foot and then pull it through for a four

goes for a big one and is caught! it was slower this time and Gilly was looking to pull it away, hits slightly higher on the bat and the pull shot goes straight to the deep mid-wicket fielder to be caught by Morgan!
does not come on to the bat and Gilly waits for it before timing it through the covers to get to 27, which is his highest score in this IPL!
fuller on the off stump and easily driven down to long-on for a single
fuller on the middle stump, driven to the cover fielder which brings us to the Time-out
short of length and on the off stump, pushed to the off side, straight to the fielder
on a length this time and on the off stump line, is able to push it to the right of the fielder and they are away for a quick one
and he swings hard, just does not get it off his bat and they have to remain content with a leg-bye there
short of length outside the off stump and opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
loud appeal for an lbw but it looked to be pitching outside the leg stump, hits his pads and rolls over to the off side
fuller on the leg stump and he takes it on the full, flicks it down to wide long-on for a couple of runs
and he goes down the track this time, but does not get it off the middle of the bat, gets it to long-on for a single
lofted over the bowler's head for a four! it was fuller, in the slot and wide enough to free his arms, Gilly was not sitting back there and hits it away for a four
short of length and that's tapped away to the mid-wicket region for a single
that's spun back a tad and Gilly defends it to the mid-off region for a single
fuller on the leg-stump, flicked away to mid-wicket for a single
short of good length but very close to the off stump, defended to the off side, not for runs
fuller on the middle stump, driven to the mid-on fielder and they are off for a quick one
that's played away through the backward point region for a four to get off the mark, it was short of length and tapped through that area to the boundary
slower this time from Kallis, on a length and outside the off stump, defended on the off side
bouncer to test him! that flies after hitting the length and he sways away, lets it go through to the keeper
and strikes first ball! he was looking to flick it away, came on slightly slower than he expected it to and the whip through the mid-wicket goes straight to the fielder inside the circle, gone!
picks up length quickly and is able to pull it away to the fence for a four!
ooh, almost taps it to the fielder at short cover, was in the air for some time before bouncing a couple of times
and now he goes after him, it was in the slot to attempt that shot, went for the slog sweep and gets it over the square-leg fielder for a four!
this is shorter in length and cut away, beats the in field and is able to come back for the second
slower, wants to cut it away, but is only able to get it to the short point fielder, they are off for a single
slower on the off stump, he has only tapped it to the off side and they are off for a quick one
fullish from Narine and defended to the off side, straight to the fielder
quicker this time, gets an outside edge as he was looking to turn that one to the leg side, through the backward point region for a four
and he's back to bowling that good length, fuller this time and beats the outside edge with ease, beats the keeper too
this is shorter in length and Madeep is quick on it, punches it through the covers and for a four!
and this one turns back into the batsman, he is able to get his bat and pad out and turn that away through square-leg for a couple of runs
whoa, almost got him, it was full enough to get him out to defend it but the turn away beats him
shot, what a superb shot from the former Aussie keeper, shorter in length and he was able to punch it through mid-wicket for a four, the quick outfield helps as well
and this time it is very full and he was looking to go back before changing that stroke and manages to drive it to the right of the bowler
it wasn't so short but he was looking to go back to cut it, does not get it off the middle and straight to point
shortish in length this time and easily tucked away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
on a good length and he taps it away to the leg side, goes through to mid-wicket for a single
shorter in length and he is able to tap it to mid-on for a single, finally a run against him
quicker this time and it goes quick enough to the deep square-leg fence for a four, pulled nicely almost as if he expected it to be a quick this time, well done
and wow, that's seemed so slow that he could have swung his bat a dozen times before it reached him, 107 km/hr and beats the bat, through to the keeper on a couple of bounces
cut away this time, was a short of length ball and that's gone straight to a wide third-man in place, single to the captain
slower one and going down the leg side with the angle, he misread the pace and wasn't able to get it away, hits the pads and they are away for a leg-bye
beaten! what a delivery, good length and there was some movement off the seam, beats the outside edge of the bat and through to the keeper
goes down the track and lifts it over the extra-cover region, almost gets to the pitch of the ball and smack, did not hit off the middle but tell you what it almost goes for a six
and that's a maiden to start things off from SS, it was fuller on the off and there was a bit of width, he wanted to drill it through the covers but does not get any timing on it
on the middle stump, no turn for SS and Gilly quietly opens the face of the bat and taps it to the off
fuller on the off stump, driven back to the bowler who dives to his right and fields
angling down the leg side, was looking to flick it away but hits his pads, missing the leg stump
not too much turn, it was on the middle stump from round the stumps and defended to the off side
fuller from the bowler, drives it back to the bowler
short of length and outside the off stump, 126.7 km/hr, wants to tap it away but the lack of pace defeats him

bit fuller and almost a run-out! he had tapped to the off side and Gilly wanted to get going for a single, Morgan swoops down quickly and tries to throw down the stumps, Gilly is miles out and the fielder misses
shot, first four and it's his quick eye to spot that slightly short of length ball, immediately rocks back and slams it over the in-field for a four!
on a good length from over the wicket, bit of angle back into the batsman and that's tapped to the leg side, to the short mid-wicket
fuller this time from Balaji and Gilly's still on the back foot, he was looking to drive it but no power on it, gets it to wide mid-off for a single
round the stumps and on a good length, tapped to the leg side by the captain
and the game ends with a no-ball, it was a full-toss that goes over the waist, given a no-ball to finish off the game
pushed across for a single and bring the new man on strike
outside the off and he wants to crash it away, misses

and this time he's caught, was looking to finish it off with a six but the full-toss is hit straight to the deep square-leg fielder, simple catch taken. Morgan was disappointed immediately after hitting that one, knew he had mis-hit it
and another one, another six, he loves those ones which are short and he's able to free his arms, it was outside the off and had enough time to pull it away for a six
beaten this time, outside the off and he was looking to run down to the third-man region, beats the outside edge of the bat
wow, banged, short of length and he has smashed it over long-on for a six, it was swung over the field there to get him his third six
jumps down the track and punched to short cover who fields well and then throws at the striker's end
slower one and it comes out as a full-toss, does not look like it's above waist, Bisla pushes it through the covers and gets him a single that gets him to his 50
a very slow ball that's pulled down to long-on for a single
slower one but's gone down the leg-side as the batsman was looking to walk across to the off side, misses but they get a bye
slower leggie from Harmeet, pushed into the covers for a single

and now Bisla does a half-Dilscoop, does not get it exactly over his head, gets the outside part of the bat and gets it over the short fine-leg, almost like Robin Uthappa during his heady days of 2007-08
down the track and wants to slam it away, inside edge and the bowler is quick to get across and prevent the single
short of length and Morgan's been dropped at mid-wicket! he was looking to pull it and it was hit flat and hard but straight to the fielder, Bhargav Bhatt spills a simple one here
and this time it's been banished over the long-leg for a six, slower, shorter and it aint surprising Bisla any more, pulled across!
poor delivery down the leg side again but it's slower and the batsman's not able to get it away too fine
down the leg side, was jumping down the track but it's too wide to get a touch on it and it's called a wide
slower bouncer and it almost had Bisla surprised, he was looking to pull it when he saw it pitched so short but had to check himself before trying to roll it down, well played in the end
full outside the off stump and it hits the bat on its bottom, goes nowhere but to the fielder
fuller, almost yorker-length but a little slow from PK, he was giving himself room, cannot get it away through the in-field
goes down the track and wants to get it through the covers, but does not get it in the gap
and now defended back to the bowler
and now slammed, second six for Morgan, it was full and outside the off, tries to compensate for it but the batsman's ready, crashes it over square-leg for a six
and that's swept very, very fine to the fence for a four, the conventional sweep, it was down the leg side from PC and easily played away
and now he wants to drive it through the covers, gets an inside edge there and to the short fine-leg fielder, gets a direct hit but the batsman is in
and wow, this time it's Bisla's turn to play the reverse sweep, goes to the point fielder
fullish on his pads this time, he's able to chip it over mid-wicket for a single
on a good length and that's easily tucked away to deep square-leg for a single
and now he sends down a poor delivery, down the pads and he's able to glance it to fine-leg for a four
and that's the fourth dot, it is outside the off stump and Morgan is kind of jumpy there, pushes it to the off
short of good length, pushed back to the bowler and that's the third dot ball of the over
gets his length back now, tapped back to the off side
fuller on the off stump and he gently taps it to the off side, to the fielder this time
easily played away to backward square-leg for a couple of runs, reduces the required rate to seven.
jags back into the batsman, he was looking to drive it through the covers, gets bit of an inside edge
bad ball, he loves bowling leggies sometimes Harmeet but this is picked well by the batsman who pulls it over the in-field for a four
slower and fuller and driven down to long-off for a single
what a six! how did that go over? he was jumping down the track and looking to only chip it over, seemed like a leading edge and it's gone over long-on for a six!
on a length outside the off stump and driven through the covers for a single
and now he walks across to the off side and scoops it over the very fine, fine-leg for a four! he's just survived a close call but that's not going to put him off from playing those shots
and that one spins back into the bat now, has to push it to the off side
that's another fuller one, wants to drive it through but hits the inside edge on to the boot and they are away for one
shorter and pushed down the ground for a single

how did that miss? that was a reverse sweep attempted first up from Morgan and that exposed his leg stump, the ball pitches on the lg stump and the ball turns away and misses the leg stump by as little as it is possible!
keeps it up to the bat and Bisla drives it down the ground for a single
and another one on the perfect line and length, Morgan can only shout a no after pushing it to the covers
on the good length, pushes it to the off side, straight to mid-off

edged and gone! Kallis has to go! a big wicket this, he was looking to run it through to third-man, gets a thin nick on it and Gilchrist takes a simple catch, his second of the innings while KKR lose their tird
fuller and on the middle, driven down to mid-off, straight to the fielder
tries to loft him over the in field by walking down the track and gets no way close to the middle of the bat, just lobs it over the bowler
on a length outside the off stump, tries to carve it through the point region but gets it straight to the point fielder, bit of a fumble but does well to recover and there's no run
and now pushed to the area between long-on and mid-wicket, it was only dabbed out there and they are able to come back for the second
slight appeal against Kallis again but it's quickly stifled, rolls over to the leg side
shorter from the bowler, turned away but he accounts well for the spin and pushes it down to long-off for a single
quicker, flatter, down the leg side and that's a wide
up and over, gives himself room, goes inside out over the extra-cover region for a four
goes for the sweep but misses, there was definite turn away again
slow turn away from the bat and easily played away to the off side for a single
pushed into the covers for a single
swept away and for a four, was fuller this time and he crashes it through the leg side for another four
pulls his length back a little and gets it to turn away from the bat, pushed into the covers for a single
fullish on the off stump and driven down the ground for a single
loud, loud shout for another lbw, and not only is it not-out but it rushes away for four leg-byes...it was a good shout, could have been hitting outside the off, but if at all, only marginally so
on a good length and he is able to tap it to the off side for a quick one
short of length but attacking the stumps this time, is able to cut it through the covers for a single
on the leg side, tucked round the corner for a single
back to bowling that fuller length, pushed to the covers
shorter, quicker but no width provided, he was looking to cut it but the lack of width works against him
fuller on the off stump, driven to the short cover fielder, not for runs
and now wants to cut a slightly shorter ball, misses the under-edge to get us to the Time-out
slows it down now and wants him to drive it through the covers again, gets it to the fielder
continues to bowl it very full, drives it to the long-on for a single
full enough but outside the off stump this time, he drives it through the covers to the deep fielder for a single
fullish this time and he was looking to play straight, the outside edge gets him a single to the covers
edged and for a four! it was fuller on the off stump, it spins away from the bat and the edge runs through the slips to the fence
slows it down now and Kallis is able to play it away to the off side for a single
fuller from him now, driven to the extra-cover fielder inside the circle
bad ball number two, good shot number two, four through backward point, it was short, wide, turning away and Kallis gives it his all, cracks it through the off side
slightly fuller now and Kallis was looking to play it forward, the ball stops a tad and turns away too, defended
short, wide and Kallis takes full toll, cuts it away for a four, through the cover
fuller from round the stumps and he plays it back to the bowler
another one that keeps low, he was playing it off the back foot and gets bit of a leading edge to mid-off
big shout for an lbw, the ball was drifting into it and there was a bit of wobble back into the bat, gets an inside edge on to the pads and the ump gets it right
outside the off and this is as slow as the previous ones, keeps a little low too and beats the outside edge of the bat
another slower one and Kallis stands tall, nudges it away to square-leg for a single
slows down the pace this time, 115 km/hr, he opens the face of the bat and nudges it to the off side for a single
gives himself room and smashes it over the covers for a six! that's well hit sir! short and wide alright but to get that timing right takes some getting!
slower one from the bowler, hes able to tuck it away to the deep square-leg for a single
and walks down again but this time Mahmood is a tad wiser, pushes it fuller at him, defended on the off side
goes down the track and this time he's pulled it, slapped it, forehanded it, and over long-on for a six! what a shot!
as looking to drive it through the covers this time, takes the outside edge of the bat, thats partially stopped at the point region
walks across to the off stump and the straightish delivery is tucked away through fine-leg for a four, the fielder was within the circle and beats him easily
on a good length on the off stump, taps it back to the off side
keeps a tad low to go with the fact that it was swinging away from the bat too, pushed to the covers
short of length outside the off, the keeper's up to the bat and he remains back in his crease and pushes it to the point fielder
a tad wider outside the off stump and he is only able to push it to the off side, straight to a fielder
walks a tad towards the ball, outside the off and pushes it to mid-off, goes for a run and Chawla has a shy at it, misses
on the off stump, on a good length too and Kallis defends it to the off side, wanted a single but Bisla shouts out a continuous set of 'Nos'
edged again and this beats the first slipper, he was going down the track and gets beaten by the bounce, the outside edge through to third-man
punched through the point for a four, that's a superb stroke, just a punch off the back foot and away it goes
short of length but the ball does not come on to the bat, wanted to crack it through but does not get his timing right
outside the off stump and fuller, but a tad wide, Kallis does not have to fiddle at it, and he does not, lets it go through
edged and gone! first ball! on a hat-trick! that's pushed and the nick goes through to the keeper, Gilly dives to his right and is easily caught by him, that's a poor prod from Pathan

bowled him, gone, swinging in and the stumps are down! not the best of shots but you got to give it to the bowler, that one was swinging back into the batsman who wanted to slam it over the mid-wicket region, hits something on the way before going on and hitting the stumps

dropped, sitter, how do you do that? it was fuller on the off stump, it did not come out too quickly and the push on the up goes straight to Mandeep Singh, who seems to be taken aback by the lack of pace on it too!

goes down the track and wants to hit it over the extra-cover but gets beaten by the bounce, the outside edge runs through to fine third-man for a four - that's two fours in the over and both in the V behind the stumps
fuller on the off stump and drives it through to the cover fielder, not for a run
gets it closer to the off stump and on a good length, tapped it to the off stump
on his pads and flicked away to fine-leg for a four, he started that one from the legstump and despite the swing to middle, it's easily deflected to fine-leg
ooh, almost an outside edge, it was deviating slightly away from the bat and GG wanted to open the face of the bat as he usually loves doing, misses the outside edge
outside the off stump and on a good length, no swing, he is able to open the face of the bat and through to the third-man for a single
